{{Top|leg}}
'''Bay Door Control''' (BDC) was responsible for opening and closing bay doors on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. They checked all orders by departing crew and checks the flight plan with [[Flight Control]]. Only if valid does the officer in charge give the order to produce a [[Force field/Legends|force field]] in the bay, strong enough to hold in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] but permeable for ships to cross. Afterward, the doors close and seal shut and the force field is turned off.
